input_ownership: caller-owned; borrowed only for the duration of the call
output_ownership: library-owned immutable byte buffers released exactly once with notrios_buffer_release
handle_type: unsigned 64-bit opaque value with generation; zero is invalid
lifecycle: open validates one named profile and owns its store, workers, secret provider, and host capabilities
calls and streams retain an instance reference but never expose one
close atomically enters shutting_down, refuses new work, cancels calls, closes streams, waits for owned workers, and invalidates the generation
close is idempotent for the same live generation; stale and foreign handles are typed refusals
all exported functions catch Go panics and return internal without unwinding through C

rest_translation.rule: one dispatch surface, not one C symbol per endpoint
never expose raw HTTP status as the ABI error taxonomy

rest_translation.abi: stream offset, requested length, total length, and end_of_stream
rest_translation.rule: bulk bytes never enter the JSON envelope

rest_translation.abi: stream mime_type and safe logical filename
call handle, deadline, cancel, and poll
rest_translation.rule: no callback from an arbitrary Go thread

rest_translation.http: authenticated peer principal and rate limits
rest_translation.abi: host-supplied capability context or retained HTTP courier
rest_translation.rule: do not weaken peer authentication by treating local FFI as a remote transport

rest_translation.http: CSP, cookies, Origin, RemoteAddr, TLS, and web root

mandatory_tests: wrong, stale, foreign, and zero handles
result release, double release, wrong-instance release, and leak accounting
stream offset, partial read, EOF, close, error, and concurrent shutdown
call deadline, cancel-before-start, cancel-during-work, poll, and shutdown
no callback on arbitrary Go threads and no Go pointer in C-visible memory
secret and path redaction in errors, logs, events, and crash handling
semantic parity against the equivalent REST application operation
